scripts.lhci:mobile: NODE_OPTIONS='--require ./scripts/lhci-unlink-fix.cjs' CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=mobile pnpm exec lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.cjs
scripts.lhci:desktop: NODE_OPTIONS='--require ./scripts/lhci-unlink-fix.cjs' CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=desktop pnpm exec lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.cjs
scripts.lhci:all: pnpm run lhci:mobile && pnpm run lhci:desktop
scripts.lhci:all:baseline: pnpm run lhci:mobile && pnpm run perf:baseline:mobile && pnpm run lhci:desktop && pnpm run perf:baseline:desktop
scripts.lhci:all:dashboard: pnpm run lhci:mobile && pnpm run perf:dashboard:mobile && pnpm run lhci:desktop && pnpm run perf:dashboard:desktop
scripts.checkpoint: bash -lc 'echo "=== CHECKPOINT ==="; echo "Branch: $(git branch --show-current)"; echo "Commit: $(git log -1 --oneline)"; echo; git status --short'
